issues.legal_issue: A widow who becomes the full owner of her inherited interest in joint family property may sell that interest without the consent of the male coparceners.
material_facts: The family was a Hindu joint family governed by the Benares School of Mitakshara law.

After her husband died, his widow acquired his interest in the joint family property under section 3(2) of the Hindu Women's Right to Property Act, 1937, initially as a limited interest under section 3(3).
The widow possessed the interest, and the challenge that she was not in possession was not pursued on appeal.
Section 14(1) of the Hindu Succession Act, 1956, made her a full owner of that interest.
She sold a share in family property for her own purposes without the male coparceners' consent, and the coparceners sued to challenge the sale and cancel the sale deed.
issues.conclusion: The widow, as full owner of the interest, could sell it for her own purposes without the consent of the male coparceners; the sale was binding on them and the appeal was dismissed.
issues.legal_principle: Under section 3(2) of the Hindu Women's Right to Property Act, 1937, a widow acquired her deceased husband's interest in joint family property, initially as a limited estate under section 3(3). Section 14(1) of the Hindu Succession Act, 1956, made property possessed by a female Hindu her full property, carrying an unrestricted right of disposition. Although a male coparcener governed by the Benares School generally could not sell his undivided share for his own benefit without the other coparceners' consent, that restriction did not apply to the widow after she became full owner; the court would not import a limitation that Parliament had not imposed. The male coparcener restriction was recognized in Madho Parshad v. Mehrban Singh, Balgobind Das v. Narain Lal, and Chandradeo Singh v. Mata Prasad.

rule.if: coparceners_challenge_widow_sale and widow_inherited_joint_family_interest and widow_held_interest_as_full_owner and widow_sold_interest_for_own_purpose

predicates.coparceners_challenge_widow_sale: Coparceners challenged a widow's sale of an interest in joint family property and sought to have the sale set aside.
predicates.widow_inherited_joint_family_interest: A surviving widow acquired her deceased husband's interest in joint family property.
predicates.widow_held_interest_as_full_owner: The widow held the inherited interest as its full owner.
predicates.widow_sold_interest_for_own_purpose: The widow sold the interest for her own purposes.

issues.definition: When coparceners challenge a widow's sale of an inherited joint-family interest, and she holds it as full owner and sells it for her own purposes, the sale binds the coparceners.
